data.name: Telesforo
data.gender_notes: Telesforo is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'tele' meaning 'distance' or 'end' and 'foros' meaning 'good news' or 'bringer of good news'. Telesforo was a Saint and Martyr in the Roman Empire. The name Telesforo carries the meaning “Bringer of good news” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Telesforo usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of hope and good tidings
data.etymology: Telesforo belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bringer of good news.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Telesforo total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Τελέσφορος
in_greek.meaning: Τελέσφορος ὅρος ἀπὸ τοῦ Τέλος + Φόρος
in_greek.long_meaning: Τελέσφορος ὅρος ἀπὸ τοῦ Τέλος + Φόρος, ὅτι ὁ Θεός ἀπὸ τὸ Τέλος τοῦ κόσμου ἐπιβραβεύει. Ἀπὸ τὸ Ἀπίστος Παῦλος, Τελέσφορος ἦν ἕνας ἀπὸ τοὺς πρώτους καθηγητὲς τοῦ Χριστοῦ. Ἐν Ἀντιόχεια, ὁ Πράξης τῆς Ἀπίστου Ἀνδρέου τὸν Τελέσφορον ἔδωκεν τὴν ἀπάντηση πρὸς τὰς ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἀντιόχου θλίψεις.

in_latin.name: Telesforus
in_latin.long_meaning: Telesforus significat finem + portare, quia Deus a fine mundi mercedem reddet. Secundum Apostolum Paulum, Telesforus fuit unus ex primis discipulis Christi. In Antiochia, Acta Apostoli Andreae dederunt Telesforo responsam ad tribulationes a Antiocho.

in_english.name: Telesforo
in_english.meaning: Telesforo means to bear the end or final reward
in_english.long_meaning: Telesforo means to bear the end or final reward, signifying that God rewards those who endure to the end. According to Apostle Paul, Telesforo was one of the first disciples of Christ. In Antioch, the Acts of Apostle Andrew gave Telesforo the answer to the tribulations from Antiochus.

data.cultural_impact: Telesforo holds historical and cultural significance in the Christian faith as a Martyr and Saint. The name Telesforo carries the legacy of a brave figure who was committed to his beliefs amidst religious persecution in the Roman Empire. Telesforo's life story and martyrdom serve as an inspiration, reminding us of the courage and resilience required to uphold our convictions. His presence in the calendar of saints' days is a testament to the impact of the early Christian martyrs on shaping the religious, cultural, and social fabric of Western civilization.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Telesforo is rooted in the power and truth of the 'good news' or 'gospel' message. The prefix 'tele' implies the bringer of the end, or the one who brings the message of salvation to its fullest realization. In the context of a Christian life, Telesforo can serve as a source of inspiration to live a life focused on spreading the gospel message and striving towards a deeper, more meaningful relationship with God. Additionally, the name Telesforo can serve as a daily reminder of the importance of standing strong in our beliefs and holding onto the hope of the gospel message, even amidst challenges and obstacles.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Telesforo, meaning "bringer of good news," embodies the spirit of spreading joy and hope. This name symbolizes the messenger role we all play in sharing God's love and truth with others.
